status: provisional development gates; fixed before the validation run; not proof of clinical accuracy; no tuning after the validation run

behaviour_among_cited_facts.note: greeting-like, polarity and segment0 flags are heuristics: every flagged case is read and listed in the report; they are gated only as shares

agreement_with_gold_cited_segments_on_st.note: denominator (matched facts with a gold citation) and matched coverage are always reported; this is not overall evidence accuracy

reported_not_gated: stage-1 P02 extraction metrics on the validation subset (first validation numbers for P02; not final)
share of cited facts whose underlying fact strictly matches a gold fact
human audit results (feasibility check; concern threshold: <75% of audited cited facts judged supported)
decision_rule: all gated criteria hold -> 'passes the provisional development gates'; otherwise report the failed gates; the rules are not changed after seeing the validation results
